content: It is never too late to be what you might have been.
author: George Eliot
story:
Preserved as part of George Eliot's enduring intellectual legacy, this reflection addresses the fundamental nature of potential and resilience. Across his life and work, George Eliot returned repeatedly to the conviction that personal integrity, honest observation, and clarity of purpose are the foundational pillars of a life well-lived.

Contemplating this truth invites us to step back from the frantic rush of daily demands. By examining our assumptions with fresh eyes, we discover the inner grounding necessary to act with wisdom and quiet conviction.
reflectionPrompt: When you look back on past hardships, how did navigating them expand your capacity for strength?
